# std/args

Raw CLI argument access.

```milo
from "std/args" import { args, getFlag, hasFlag }
```

## Example

```milo
if hasFlag("verbose") {
    print("verbose on")
}
match getFlag("output") {
    Option.Some(path) => print($"Writing to {path}"),
    Option.None => print("Writing to stdout"),
}
```

`getFlag` reads the `--name value` form only; `--name=value` is not recognised. For
anything richer, use [`std/argparse`](argparse).

## API reference

### `args`

```milo
pub fn args(): Vec<string>
```

Return all command-line arguments as a Vec&lt;string>.
Index 0 is the program name.

### `getFlag`

```milo
pub fn getFlag(name: &string): string?
```

Get the value following a --name flag.
None if the flag is absent or is the last argument. Only the `--name value`
form is recognised, not `--name=value`.
Example: getFlag("port") returns the value after --port.

### `hasFlag`

```milo
pub fn hasFlag(name: &string): bool
```

Check if a --name flag is present in the arguments.
